General Guidance (all stages)

  • Keep the Stage aligned with where the Opportunity stands with the customer
  • Use Next Step field to capture the most important upcoming action needed to move the opportunity forward
  • Use Activity Notes to document meaningful conversations or updates
  • If the customer decides not to proceed at any point, update the opportunity to Closed Lost

Discovery & Solution Building

  • Clarify the customer’s requirements and solution needs
  • Continue discussions to refine the opportunity
  • Document discovery conversations in Activity Notes when relevant

Exit Criteria

  • Move forward when the customer begins reviewing the quote and discussing pricing or scope.

Negotiation / Review

  • Work through final questions or adjustments
  • Confirm the customer is aligned and preparing to place the order
  • Document key discussions or approvals in Activity Notes

Exit Criteria

  • Opportunity will automatically move to Closed Won when an order is created
  • If the customer decides not to proceed with the order, update the opportunity to Closed Lost

Proposal / Price Quote

  • Follow up with the customer regarding the quote
  • Address questions or requested adjustments
  • Capture customer feedback or questions in Activity Notes

Exit Criteria

  • Move forward when final pricing or deal terms are being discussed.

Prospecting

  • Confirm customer interest in the opportunity
  • Enter a Next Step describing the planned follow-up or action with the customer
  • Capture important early conversations in Activity Notes when applicable

Exit Criteria

  • Move forward once the Next Step field has been defined and there is a clear action to progress the opportunity.
